title: feat(console): filter and page the marketplace catalog through the list door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X3TFS5tXyqCwM19gKCYSVFj)_

Fixes #31267

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:控制台市场页不再一次拉 100 条再在浏览器里筛。搜索词、三个维度的选择和分页窗口随列表请求一起发给 `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages`:`businessFunctions` / `industries` / `solutionTypes` 各一个逗号拼接的参数,没选的维度不发,`q` 在停止输入 300 毫秒后发,`limit` / `offset` 由卡片下方的翻页器驱动(每页 24 条)。`listMarketplacePackages` 还接受 `maturity`,页面本身不选它。
- 为什么改:#31234 已让服务端按这四个维度筛选并分页;前端筛只看得到前 100 条,目录超过 100 条后其余模板永远显示不出来。
- 风险与回滚:只改私有包 `@object-ui/app-shell` 的市场页(随 `@object-ui/console` 的构建发出),patch。可见变化:维度按钮现在列出规格声明的全部取值、不再显示数量(一页筛选结果数不出全目录,列表接口也不返回计数);搜索改由服务端匹配(名称与应用 ID,与占位文字一致),不再匹配描述和本地化名称。默认配置下请求原样转发 cloud,cloud 按同名参数筛选要等 cloud#3661。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePage.tsx`(`catalogRequest`、读取 effect、翻页器)、`marketplaceApi.ts` 的 `listMarketplacePackages`(参数拼法)、`marketplaceTaxonomy.ts` 的 `facetListParams` 与 `widenServedFacets`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.facets-31011.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/marketplaceApi.listQuery-31267.test.ts`,预期 17 个用例全绿(点按钮、打字、翻页,断言列表请求收到的查询串)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`listMarketplacePackages`** (`marketplaceApi.ts`) takes `MarketplaceListParams`: `q`, `limit`, `offset`, and the four filters of `MarketplaceSearchRequestSchema` spelled as the published spec names them, `businessFunctions`, `industries`, `solutionTypes` (plural) and `maturity`. Each list filter goes out as ONE comma-joined parameter; a list that selects nothing is left out, never sent empty; `maturity` is one value; `category` is never sent. These are exactly the three shapes the list door refuses with 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` (empty facet, repeated facet key, retired `category`), so the console sends none of them.
- **`MarketplacePage.tsx`** no longer reads `{ limit: 100 }` and filters in the browser. Its read is `catalogRequest`: the debounced search text as `q`, the selection through `facetListParams`, `limit: CATALOG_PAGE_SIZE` (24) and the page's `offset`. One effect reads whenever that request's spelling changes; each new read retires the pending one, so only the newest settles the page (the existing `loadSeq` mechanism). The first read, Refresh, Retry and the read after an install also read the installs and the org's packages; a page turn or a new selection reads the catalog alone. The search box reads once typing pauses for `SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS` (300 ms). A new search or selection reads from the first page. The cards drawn are the door's answer, unfiltered. Empty answers say "No apps match your filters." under a search or a selection and "No apps have been approved…" without one.
- **Pager.** Under the cards when the door's `total` spans more than one page: Previous, "Page N of M", Next, disabled at either end and while a read is pending. It reuses the existing keys `common.previous`, `common.next` and `table.pageInfo`; no i18n key is added, removed or reworded.
- **Facets** (`MarketplaceFacetFilters.tsx`, `marketplaceTaxonomy.ts`). A drawn facet offers every value the spec declares, in the spec's order, read from the schemas' `.options` as before. The per-value count is gone, and so are `matchesFacets` and `facetOptions`: one page of the filtered catalog cannot count the catalog, and the list door answers no counts. Which facets are drawn is `ServedFacets`, widened by `widenServedFacets` from each answer: a facet appears once some answered listing carries it (the solution type once one declares a type) and stays drawn while a selection narrows the page, so a catalog serving no taxonomy still draws no filter (the #31011 behaviour).
- **Row defaults (card item 4).** The console no longer applies a default to filter: the server does (`solutionTypes` reads a row without the column as `app`, `maturity` as `stable`). The one console reading that remains, `effectiveSolutionType` on the package page, is `DEFAULT_SOLUTION_TYPE` from `@objectstack/spec/marketplace`, the same constant the door imports; the Beta badge reads `maturity === 'beta'`, so an absent maturity draws as `stable`. No second copy of either default is added.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/31267-marketplace-server-facets.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, with both declaration lines (precedent: `.changeset/30330-marketplace-readme-fits-page.md`, an app-shell-only change shipped through `@object-ui/console`'s `dist`).

## Tests

- `MarketplacePage.facets-31011.test.tsx`, the page's existing harness, rewritten for the server read (15 cases). The catalog stub records each list read's query string and answers from a per-test function. Every click, keystroke and page turn goes through the rendered page; the assertions read the query the data layer sent: keys, comma-joined values in the spec order, an omitted empty facet, no `category`, no empty value, at most one occurrence of each key, `limit` / `offset`. One case answers a `hr` read with listings that carry no `hr` and asserts both are drawn: the console filters nothing. The pager case walks three pages by `offset` and checks that a selection on page 2 reads from offset 0. The #31011 cases that still hold (facets hide with no taxonomy, per-facet hiding, out-of-vocabulary values drawn nowhere, non-array columns, primary-function and Beta badges) stay, read through the server answer.
- `marketplaceApi.listQuery-31267.test.ts` (new, 2 cases): the exact URL `listMarketplacePackages` builds for all four filters, `maturity` included, and that empty lists and no filters send nothing extra.
- `MarketplacePage.searchPlaceholder-10900.test.tsx`: its third case pinned the browser-side search; it now asserts the box's text reaches the read as trimmed `q` from offset 0, and that the door's empty answer draws no card. The placeholder's promise (name or app ID) is the door's `q` matching, `catalogRowMatches` in `@objectstack/cloud-connection`'s marketplace proxy.

## Acceptance notes

- **Counts are gone from the facet buttons.** #31011 drew, beside each value, the loaded listings that held it. With the server filtering and paging, no count the console could compute would be true, and `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages` answers `{ items, total, limit, offset }` with no aggregation. The spec does declare an optional `facets` member on `MarketplaceSearchResponseSchema` (one count list per facet), but no in-repo producer serves it, so the console does not read it. If counts are wanted back, the list door serving those counts is the route; noted, not filed.
- **Search moved to the server, and narrowed with it.** The browser search matched the localized display name, the manifest id and the localized description. The door's `q` (proxy path) matches `display_name` and `manifest_id`, which is what the placeholder says ("by name or app ID"). Matching the description or a localized name is gone; noted, not filed.
- **Default configuration forwards to cloud.** With `OS_MARKETPLACE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` unset, the proxy validates the query and forwards it verbatim to the cloud list route, which adopts the same names on cloud#3661 (carrier: cloud). Until that lands, a deployment on the default path may answer a facet read unfiltered; the console draws what it is answered. The R2 fast path filters in-repo.
- **Maturity** is accepted by `listMarketplacePackages` (card item 1) and pinned there; the page selects no maturity, as before (maturity is a badge, not a facet, in the spec's own words).
- **Page size 24**: a whole number of card-grid rows at two, three, four and six columns; the door caps a page at 100.

## Verification

All on head `aad134cc` unless named. Exit codes captured before any pipe.

<details><summary>Rendered and unit tests: 58/58 files, 515/515 tests</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/` under the verification lock: `Test Files 58 passed (58)`, `Tests 515 passed (515)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `eslint` on the seven changed files: 0 errors (warnings only; the read effect's `exhaustive-deps` warning was already on `main`'s effect, and the debounce effect adds one of the same kind).
- `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations, exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations: six mutations, each red, each restored to the HEAD blob</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `f7c43530`, running the three changed test files; ui vitest reads app-shell from `src/`, so no build sits between mutation and run. Every leg printed `ok restored: blob == HEAD` with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- A, an empty facet sent (`if (values)` for `if (values && values.length > 0)` in `listMarketplacePackages`): 1 red, `leaves out a filter that selects nothing, and never sends category`.
- B, the selection kept off the read (`...facetParams,` deleted from `catalogRequest`): 7 red, every case that clicks a facet. The first attempt at B used a replacement that was a substring of the anchor; the script refused it (rise 0, nothing ran), so it was redone with `--delete`.
- C, repeated keys instead of one comma-joined value (`usp.append` per value): 3 red.
- D, the old window (`limit: 100`, no `offset`): 6 red, including the pager and the search placeholder case.
- E, insertion order instead of the spec order in `facetListParams`: 1 red, `businessFunctions=sales,hr` expected.
- F, a facet that does not stay drawn (`served.businessFunctions ||` removed in `widenServedFacets`): 1 red, `a drawn facet stays drawn when a selection narrows the page`.
</details>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, reconciled with `--ran`: `37 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.

- The 27 families the ui paths derive ran on `f7c43530` (the code commit): `check-closing-keyword-parity` (and `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check-sdui-manifest` (and `--self-test`), `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, spec `check:duration-unit-keys`, `check:error-code-provenance`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:registry-log-declared`, `check:rest-log-spy-declared`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:tier-file-adoption`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, `check:where-matcher`: all exit 0.
- The 10 families the changeset path adds ran on `aad134cc`: `check-adr-0087-registration` (`--base origin/main` and `--self-test`), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` (`--base origin/main` and `--self-test`), `ci/snapshot-next --self-test`, `pm/release-rehearsal-clone --self-test`, `release-pending-publish --self-test`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`: all exit 0.
